title: Release Recording Charge (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Retention Remittances)
content:
## Release recording charge — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the release recording charge is part of the retention remittance.

The release recording charge is USD 48.00 for each of three instruments (the lender's mortgage, the Secretary's second mortgage and the trustee's certification) for a HECM whose occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product is a Living Trust Certification, and USD 48.00 for each of two instruments (the lender's mortgage and the Secretary's second mortgage) for any other HECM; a Summit loan takes no adjustment under this rule.

| Loan | Instruments | Release recording charge |
|---|---|---|
| HECM, occupancy profile a Living Trust Certification | 3 | USD 144.00 |
| HECM, any other occupancy profile | 2 | USD 96.00 |
| Summit loan | — | no adjustment under this rule |
